name: Demonstration Designer
author: Brett
description: Pitch the product in three picks and one button. Pick a plugin, screen or UI element from the live registry, pick a length in minutes, pick a narrator voice, press Generate: the designer writes a pitch script with zero tokens (a hook up front, benefits instead of specs, a closing call to action), picks the best screens, and plays a polished demo on the console's real data with a spotlight on each control, smooth zooms and pans, captions, soft background music and a logo intro and outro. Afterwards tweak the words, preview again, export the recording as a video (MP4 when the server has ffmpeg, WebM otherwise) or copy a share link that opens and plays it. Demos are demonstration@1 assets (reusable, chainable into tours, indexed by the glossary); recordings are clip@1 assets. Advanced work (a step timeline, record a demo by doing it) stays folded away. Every action and setting is also on REST, the MCP tools demonstration_designer_*, `axf demonstration-designer …` and the voice actions pitch.*; the deep link ?axf-demo=<id> opens it. Pipelines mode: a library of demo pipelines of different types (voice to app, add a feature, skin swap, parallel split build, fix a failing build, new project from a template, approval flow), each a guided walkthrough with narrated chapters you can skip while the console follows along to each screen, and a behind-the-scenes terminal (docked, floated or full screen, colour-coded, filterable) streaming the orchestrator, model picks, step splits, agent log, git, tests and axHub calls; replayed offline or run live on the test-sandbox project; made and edited in the designer; reachable on REST, the MCP tools demonstration_designer_pipeline_*, `axf demonstration-designer pipeline-…`, the voice actions pipeline.* and ?axf-pipeline=<id>.

items.title: What can be pitched
items.description: Every plugin, screen and UI element the repo registers, with the plain words a pitch is written from; q filters by words, kind by plugin, screen or ui-element.
items.output: { items: [{ id, kind, label, description, screens }] }

items.title: List pitch demos
items.description: Every saved demo with its steps, running time, topic, narrator, chain and recordings.

items.title: One pitch demo
items.description: The demonstration@1 asset of a demo plus its pitch facts (minutes, topic, product, call to action, plan).

items.title: Generate a pitch
items.description: Write the pitch script of a topic with zero tokens: a hook, the best screens with highlighted controls, a call to action, fitted to the minutes asked for, in the narrator voice given; saved unless save is false.

topic.description: a registry id: plugin:ui-review, screen:home, ui-element:console-web:x

voice.description: narrator voice name, blank = device default, silent = captions only

items.title: Save a pitch demo
items.description: Store a demo (an asset@1 object with demonstration@1 data and optional pitch facts), validated and normalised.

items.title: Delete a pitch demo
items.description: Remove a demo; its recordings stay as clips.

items.title: The script as text
items.description: The demo's words as plain text: one block per step, a '# Title' line then what the narrator says.

items.title: Apply a tweaked script
items.description: The text (blocks split on blank lines) becomes the steps' words; each block keeps the action and target of the step at its position.

items.title: Chain demos into a tour
items.description: Set the demos that play after this one; an empty list clears the chain.

items.title: The demo as walkthrough@1
items.description: The demo and its chain as one playable walkthrough@1 (steps of say, do, target).

items.title: Share link
items.description: The deep link that opens the designer on this demo, and the one that plays it at once (?axf-demo=<id>&axf-autoplay=1).

items.title: Designer settings
items.description: Every setting: script (minutes, product, call to action, pace), narration (voice, speed, captions), stage (zoom, highlight, controls, logo), music (on, volume, mood), export (format, transcode, keep) and advanced.

items.title: Change a setting
items.description: Change settings: { section: { key: value } } or { key: 'music.volume', value: 12 }. Unknown keys are dropped; values are clamped.

items.title: List recordings
items.description: Every recording kept as a clip@1: the demo it shows, its file, seconds and whether an MP4 exists.
items.output: { items: [{ id, name, demo, video, seconds, recordedAt, mp4 }] }

items.title: Upload a recording
items.description: Raw video bytes of a recording the stage made (query: id, seconds, mime); kept under media/, registered as a clip, transcoded to MP4 when ffmpeg is on the server and the export setting says so.

items.title: One recording file
items.description: The video file of a recording by its name under media/.

items.title: Cloud narrator voices
items.description: The agents whose cloud voice can narrate a pitch (from the speech capability, axf.speech@1); a narrator value of agent:<id> uses one, and an exported video then carries the voice.
items.output: { available, items: [{ value, label, agentId, provider, voice }] }

items.title: Speak one line in a cloud narrator voice
items.description: The words of a step as audio/mpeg in an agent's cloud voice (narrator agent:<id>); the stage plays it and mixes it into an exported video. Spends the provider's credits (cached per line).

items.title: Export a recording as MP4
items.description: Transcode a recording (clip id) to MP4 with the server's ffmpeg; answers with an error naming the gap when there is none.

items.title: List pipeline demos
items.description: Every pipeline demo: the built-in library (voice to app, add a feature, skin swap, parallel split build, fix a failing build, new project from a template, approval flow) and the ones made in the designer, with chapters, running time, screens and whether a live run is recorded.

items.title: One pipeline demo
items.description: A pipeline-demo@1: its chapters (title, narration, the screen focus mode moves to, an element), the behind-the-scenes lines of each and the live probes it runs.

id.description: a pipeline demo id: voice-to-app, add-feature, skin-swap, parallel-split, auto-fix, new-project, approval-flow, or one of yours

items.title: Save a pipeline demo
items.description: Store a pipeline demo made or edited in the designer (validated; saving under a built-in id makes a copy that shadows it).

items.title: Delete a pipeline demo
items.description: Remove a saved pipeline demo and its recording; a built-in can't be deleted (removing a saved copy of one brings it back).

id.description: a pipeline demo id: voice-to-app, add-feature, skin-swap, parallel-split, auto-fix, new-project, approval-flow, or one of yours

items.title: Copy a pipeline demo
items.description: Copy a demo (built-in or saved) so it can be edited in the designer; as = the new id.

items.title: What a pipeline demo plays
items.description: The demo, its timeline (chapters with start seconds, every behind-the-scenes line with its second) and the recording time; script = ignore the recording; speed gives the wall-clock length.

items.title: Behind-the-scenes lines
items.description: Everything a pipeline demo shows behind the scenes, filtered: kind = orchestrator, model, split, agent, git, test, axhub, focus, error (comma separated); q = words that must all appear.
items.output: { items: [{ t, chapter, kind, text, source? }] }

items.title: Run a pipeline demo live
items.description: Run each chapter's probes for real on the test-sandbox project and this checkout (git log and status, sandbox builds, model policy, rules splitter, self-test, theme check, agent slots, a dry-run axHub payload). Read-only: nothing is written, committed or sent. The output is kept as the demo's recording, which the next replay plays.

items.title: The recorded live run
items.description: The pipeline-recording@1 of the demo's last live run: what an offline replay plays.

id.description: a pipeline demo id: voice-to-app, add-feature, skin-swap, parallel-split, auto-fix, new-project, approval-flow, or one of yours

items.title: Which demo a phrase names
items.description: The pipeline demo a spoken or typed phrase names ("run the voice-to-app demo", "show me the skin swap").

items.title: Pipeline demo deep link
items.description: The link that opens the designer on a pipeline demo (?axf-pipeline=<id>); play starts it, live runs it live first.

items.title: Pipeline types, screens and probes
items.description: What the designer offers: the pipeline types, the screens a chapter can move to, and the live probes a chapter can run.

items.title: What the pipeline player is doing
items.description: The open console's pipeline player: demo, status, second, chapter and its screen, speed, replay or live, panel dock and filter. Drive it with the console actions pipeline.run, pipeline.pause, pipeline.resume, pipeline.next, pipeline.prev, pipeline.chapter, pipeline.restart, pipeline.speed, pipeline.dock, pipeline.filter, pipeline.stop.
items.output: { demo, status, at, total, chapter, speed, playMode, dock, panel, kinds, q, follow, reportedAt }

items.title: Report the player state
items.description: The open console reports its pipeline player state here so the API can read it; not a control.
